entries.summary: Root cause = stale-pom overwrite in S2ST commit fac9edb. ION-16159 pin/exclusion compatibility PROVEN via dependency:tree (BUILD SUCCESS): jest 5.3.3 & aws-signing 0.0.22 work with 4.4.16/4.5.14/5.4.3.
entries.detail:
Root cause of the OWASP revert: commit fac9edb 'ION-16052 - S2ST Framework changes' (Sandeep Gonthkar, 2026-07-15) has parent 1625bd0 (ION-16159 PR#43 merge). Its parent's commons/pom.xml (blob 91686b9) CONTAINS the httpcomponents pins, but fac9edb's diff reverts commons/pom.xml back to blob a096fa1 (the exact pre-ION-16159 content) and reverts pom.xml (41 lines). i.e. the S2ST feature commit committed STALE copies of pom.xml and commons/pom.xml from before it pulled ION-16159, silently wiping the vuln fix. PR#42 (2745d3a) then merged this to develop -> develop HEAD is unpinned/vulnerable.

Compatibility PROVEN via isolated worktree at e9bce53, `mvn -pl commons dependency:tree`: BUILD SUCCESS, resolves httpcore5 5.4.3, httpcore5-h2 5.4.3, jest 5.3.3 (retains jest-common + httpasyncclient 4.1.3), httpcore 4.4.16, httpcore-nio 4.4.16, httpclient 4.5.14; aws-signing 0.0.22 retained. Baseline (feature, no pins) was httpcore5 5.4/h2 5.3.4, jest->httpcore-nio 4.4.6/httpclient 4.5.3, aws-signing->httpcore 4.4.1. Pins are latest patches of the SAME minor lines jest/aws-signing already use -> API-compatible, nothing dropped. CVEs: httpcore5<=5.4.2 CVE-2026-54399 (header DoS, fixed 5.4.3); httpclient5 5.4.0-5.4.2 CVE-2025-27820 (PSL/cookie, fixed 5.4.3, httpclient5 already 5.4.4); httpclient<4.5.13 CVE-2020-13956.
Apps: booking declares own jest 6.3.0 (+local-elasticsearch, elasticsearch); tx-tracking uses org.elasticsearch:elasticsearch; visibility uses elasticsearch-rest-high-level-client (+jest in visibility-matcher). All rely on HttpComponents 4.4.x/4.5.x -> compatible with pinned 4.4.16/4.5.14 (upward within same minor). Residual: httpasyncclient 4.1.3 not pinned by ION-16159 (latest 4.1.5) - minor.</detail>
